release_title: v1.0.1 - Gestures, External Player & Performance Improvements
release_notes:
• Volume swipe gesture: drag up/down on video player to adjust volume
• External video player support: open streams directly in VLC, MX Player, or MPV
• VPN troubleshooting hints for geo-restricted streams
• Fixed resume status placement & download page light theme contrast
• Dual SUB/DUB badge logic & automated GitHub release pipeline
